Method of Attack: Trojan subscribes users to premium services without consent
Opens phishing site to steal phone numbers and confirmation codes
Runs commands from command and control (C2) server to download arbitrary web resources
Attack Vector: Fake apps on Google Play masquerading as legitimate apps (e.g., fake Alisa app, fake Viber and AliExpress apps)
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing site requesting phone number and confirmation code
Fake client for Yandex's voice assistant Alisa
Trojan included in fake versions of popular apps
